import { PencilIcon, ShareIcon, TrashIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"

export default function DropdownMenuDestructive() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <Button variant="outline">Actions</Button>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <PencilIcon />
            Edit
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <ShareIcon />
            Share
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
            <TrashIcon />
            Delete
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  )
}
